spans.s: --one of the two gods forming a boat to cross the ocean of सम्सार। वा. १०८. ३७; १११. ७२. [page३-150+ २६]

(I)--(also वामनक): the fifteenth incarna- tion of Hari to do good to Indra. Second of the अवतार्स् (म्।प्।)।
1: भा.

(II)--an elephant at one of the four cardinal points to maintain the balance of the worlds;
1: भा. V. २०. ३९; वा. ६९. ६९.
son of इरावती.
2: Br.
(V)--a son of Bhadra, the elephant. वा. ६९. २१३. [page३-193+ २७]
(VI)--a son of वामदेव; his wife was अन्गदा; two sons; अञ्जनश्याम and साम्न who were good looking animals fit for riding by men. वा. ६९. २२३-4; Br.
--a son of अजातशत्रु, ruled for २४ years. M. २७२. १०.
--(लोमहर्षण; also महात्म); the सूत who heard the वायु पुराण direct from व्यास. वा. 4. 2, 4.
--a R. from Mahendra hills. Br. II. १६. ३७; वा. ४५. १०६.
--historians and chroniclers (also वम्शवित्तमस्). Br. III. ६३. १६९ and १७१; वा. ८८. १७१.
--five are distinguished; शङ्कर्षण, वासु- deva, Pradyumna, साम्ब and Aniruddha. वा. ९७. 2.
--dynastic lists, one of the five characteristics of a पुराण।

--one of the five characteristics of a पुराण;
1: Br.
--a R. on the banks of which is the forest सुरभी. M. १२१. ६१.
(II)--a son of भूत and सरूपा: a Rudra. भा.
(III)--a son of कृष्ण and भद्रा. भा. X. ६१. १७.

. ३१.
five faced शिव grew angry at Soma's refusal to send back तारा to बृहस्पति and waged war with him.
4: Ib. २३. ३६.
(III)--a son of हीरण्यरेतस् of कुशद्वीप. भा. V. २०. १४.

(IV)--a sage who was invited for युधिष्- ठिर's राजसूय. Went with कृष्ण to मिथिला, and came to स्यमन्तपञ्चक to see him. One of the sages who left for पिण्डारक;
1: भा. X. ७४. 8; ८४. 5; ८६. १८;

-१२.
a sage by तपस्: an Angirasa and मन्त्रकृत्;
2: Br. II. ३२. ९९ and ११०; M. १४५. ९३, १०४; वा. ५९. ९०, १०१.
a son of सुरूपा and a गोत्रकार;
3: M. १९६. 4.
a Tripravara, not to marry with Angiras and बृहदुक्तस्.
4: Ib. १९६. ३५-36.
[page३-191+ ३६]

(V)--a son of Atharvan Angiras: visited परशुराम in penance;
1: Br.

. १०५; २३. 4; IV. ३९. ५६.
a ऋषि by तपस्;
2: M. १४५. ९३.
father of Asija and बृहदुत्थ.
3: वा. ६५. १००-2.
(VII)--the contemplated being in the ३०थ् Kalpa; also शर्व; वाम I1s4vara leads to Rudralokam. वा. २२. २५, ३२ and ३४.
(VIII)--the name of the Lord of the Lohita Kalpa. वा. २३. ७०-3.
(IX)--a son of गुहावास of the १७थ् dva1para. वा. २३. १७७.

--a सूक्त of the साम सम्हित recited in tank ritual;
1: M. ५८. ३७.
to be uttered in installing a new image.
2: Ib. २६५. २७.
--a mountain in क्रौञ्चद्वीप. Br. II. १९. ६७; वा. ४९. ६१; Vi.
--a mountain sacred to ललितापीठ. Br. IV. ४४. ९९.
--a महापुराण comprising ten thousand श्लोकस् (a lac of श्लोकस् वा। प्।) (see वामनम्). भा.
verses, with the माहात्म्य of Trivikrama and dealing with Trivarga in the कूर्म Kalpa; he who gives it in the विषु of शरद् attains वैष्णवहोओद् (see वामनपुराण). M. ५३. ४५-6.
--on the west is the Utkala and on the east the country of the आवेदिन्स्; belongs to the son of एकभू. वा. ६९. २४०.
--आत्रेय gotraka1ras; पुत्रिकापुत्रस् of Atri. M. १९७. 3 and 9. [page३-194+ २५]
--a R. of the भद्रा continent. वा. ४३. ३०.
